text: make a logo for my bakery
withheld: The bakery name is Mooncrumb, with no other text.
A gold crescent moon goes above dark navy lettering.
The logo should be square, 640 by 640 pixels.
The file should be a PNG with a truly transparent background so it can go on different backgrounds.
There should be no white box or drawn checkerboard behind the logo.
The font and exact color shades are up to you.
